name: Litomyšl Castle
description: Litomyšl Castle stands in the centre of the Bohemian town of Litomyšl, in eastern Czechia. Built in the 16th century, it is one of the country's largest Renaissance castles. Its façade is covered in intricate sgraffito that looks like carved stone, and arcaded galleries wrap around its courtyards. Baroque touches were added in the 1700s, including a lavish little theatre, and the surrounding service buildings survive intact.
